lessons_used: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in immediately after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path layouts, and custom pet style selector views.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility copy, desktop dock placement guidance banners, and desktop control action video cards.

No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence banners and flows, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, and archetype selector flows.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, split view story intros, and all tests showing no clear effect or negative performance.

decisions.title: Stage Layout Desktop Companion Welcome Redesign

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in immediately after pet adoption, photo quality callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path layouts, custom pet style selector views, and pre-upload style inspection views consistently won.

Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility copy, desktop dock guidance banners, desktop video cards/welcome redesigns, and interactive sound/visual wait progress led to significant losses.

No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence banners and flows, subsequent sign-in reordering, diagnostic/archetype flows, waiting overlays/indicators, visibility prompts, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, custom pet style selectors, and pre-upload style inspection views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests showing negative performance or no clear effect.
